traits.zh: 有城市限定特饮‘上海咖啡’，含麦乳精与司考奇

traits.zh: 外滩源店是全国首家臻选咖啡·酒坊，主打Mixato融合饮品
traits.en: Waitanyuan store is China’s first Reserve Coffee & Wine Bar with Mixato drinks
